label: How many prescribed medicines or tablets do you regularly take at age 69 years
meta_rows: How many prescribed medicines or tablets do you regularly take at age 69 years

This variable refers to derived regular medication data. This was asked at 1977, 1982, 1989, 1999, 2006-10, 2015 and 2023 data collection waves. Medication in the last 24 hours was only asked at the 2006-10 nurse schedule.
cat_rows: Medication derivations at data collection level (cross-sectional) [505221]
This category contains information about the regular medication taken by the participant - derived at the data collection level.
val_rows: Question only asked on Postal Home Visit
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
